title: formpdf

catalog.name: FormPDF
catalog.summary: A PDF editor that runs on your computer: view, comment, fill, sign and edit.

notes_for_owner: Not in formportal's products.json: the catalog entry is written from the README and tauri.conf.json (no project file type: the app opens .pdf). plugins.updater.pubkey is empty, so the app skips update checks until a key pair is made. Linux installs libayatana-appindicator3-dev, the package Tauri 2 documents and formpdf's own setup/install_desktop asks for (the tray library is loaded at run time, so either builds; libxdo-dev is not needed). Since formpdf 0.56.9 a release build (FORMCOMPILER_VERSION set) fails when the OCR packages do not install or the frozen engine's selfcheck does not report OCR, unless FORMPDF_NO_OCR=1 is set on purpose.
